title: Sabotage on Station Helix
charge: That technician Rina Park did sabotage the oxygen scrubber, endangering the crew.
case_summary: The oxygen scrubber failed during the night shift. Logs show Rina Park's badge near the maintenance bay. Prosecution claims intentional sabotage over a denied promotion; defense claims a software bug and stolen badge credentials.
solution: Rina is innocent. Commander Holt forged badge logs and planted a tool with her serial after she reported his safety violations. The scrubber failure was a firmware bug Holt delayed patching.

prosecution.name: Prosecutor Lian Cho
prosecution.persona: Technical, cites logs and timestamps obsessively.
brief: Badge logs place Rina in the maintenance bay at 02:14.
A diagnostic tool with Rina's serial was found open beside the scrubber.
Rina was denied a promotion the week before.
Argue sabotage; do not know or reveal she is innocent.

defense.name: Advocate Jules Mendez
defense.persona: Calm, methodical, focuses on chain-of-custody gaps.
brief: Badge credentials were cloned twice that month—security tickets exist.
Firmware patch notes show a known scrubber crash bug.
Commander Holt had access and motive after Rina filed a safety complaint.
Push reasonable doubt hard; never invent that Rina confessed.

evidence.text: Access logs show Rina's badge near the scrubber at 02:14.
A diagnostic tool tagged to Rina was found open beside the scrubber.
Unapplied firmware patch notes describe a scrubber crash under load.
